brief:
Al-Quds University has released a comprehensive guide outlining the admission procedures for candidates interested in pursuing diploma or bachelor's degree programs at the institution, according to Ma'an Wire. The resource breaks down each step of the application process in accessible language designed to help prospective students navigate enrollment requirements.

University officials positioned the guide as a foundational resource for applicants beginning their academic journey. The material covers the full range of pathways available to new students seeking to enroll in the university's diploma and undergraduate offerings.
